figures.finding: Screenwriters' body is the Bulgarian Association of the Film, Television and Radio Scriptwriters (BAFTRS), founded in Sofia in 2006 and a member of the Federation of Screenwriters in Europe; it protects members' professional interests but its pages publish no rate card or agreement.
